en-US.longDescription: Navicat for SQL Server offers a fully graphical approach to efficient database management. It enables quick creation, editing, and deletion of database objects, along with the execution of SQL queries. Our intuitive interface allows you to modify the data model interactively, while insightful analytics on query performance and database interactions empower you to optimize your SQL Server environments effectively.
